facts: The Indian Penal Code defines the punishment for giving false evidence.
A trial before a Court-martial is considered a judicial proceeding.
An investigation directed by law preliminary to a proceeding before a Court of Justice is also a stage of a judicial proceeding.
An investigation directed by a Court of Justice according to law, and conducted under the authority of a Court of Justice, is a stage of a judicial proceeding.
holding: Whoever intentionally gives false evidence in any stage of a judicial proceeding, or fabricates false evidence for the purpose of being used in any stage of a judicial proceeding, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine,
